title: Structure-Agnostic Unitary Learning from Quantum Observable Dynamics with Application to Hamiltonian Identification
summary: We present a variational algorithm for learning an unknown quantum unitary from time-series observable measurements, with no structural assumption about the target. The core separation: a hardware-efficient parametrised circuit learns the evolution operator U via observable matching; Hamiltonian identification follows as classical post-processing via matrix logarithm, when the target happens to be exp(-iH*tau).
